summary: Academy Sports & Outdoors, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Academy, Ltd., issued $500 million of 5.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 in a private placement. Net proceeds were used to redeem outstanding 2027 senior secured notes, prepay the entire $400 million term loan, and for general corporate purposes. The notes are first-priority secured on substantially all personal property (excluding ABL collateral). This is a routine debt refinancing and liability management transaction, not a special situation event.
